attributes.title: APsA 2027 National Meeting
attributes.summary:
The American Psychoanalytic Association's 2027 National Meeting runs Tuesday, February 2 to Friday, February 5, 2027, in Washington, DC, with administrative meetings on February 1. APsA is taking applications for the poster session. Dr. Nicolle Zapien will give the 2027 Ticho Memorial Award lecture at the meeting.

APsA is a jointly accredited provider. It offers CME for physicians, CE for psychologists through APA co-sponsorship, ASWB ACE credit for social workers and NBCC credit for counselors (ACEP No. 7556), and it holds New York State approvals for social workers, psychologists and psychoanalysts. Only sessions marked for CE qualify. The 2027 program, credit totals, venue details and registration fees are not published yet.
